captures.description: THE CENTER, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Electronic Poetry Center is a major online archive and resource gateway for digital, experimental, and avant-garde poetry.' Overview & History (founded 'July 10, 1994, by Loss Pequeño Glazier and Charles Bernstein'; the Poetics Program at SUNY Buffalo; E-Poetry 2001); Key Resources & Features (author libraries; the E-Poetry section; partnerships with PennSound and UbuWeb). Four cards: the center at the University of Pennsylvania, Wikipedia, the ELMCIP Knowledge Base, poets.org.

atoms.evidence: Overview: Electronic Poetry Center (EPC) is an online resource for digital poetry
Founded: July 10, 1994, by Loss Pequeño Glazier and Charles Bernstein.
is a major online archive and resource gateway for digital, experimental, and avant-garde poetry.
Author Libraries: Curated collections of contemporary poet pages containing biographies, photos, essays, and links to online works.
Origin: Created as part of the Poetics Program at the State University of New York (SUNY) at Buffalo.
